findings.message: The covering lemma is the known diameter of S^2/O. The submission itself says the main containment S ⊆ 3·P(S) follows from it by a short elementary argument. Two applications of the covering lemma give R(S) ≤ √3·r(S) and P(S) ⊇ (r/√3)·B, and the cube's sharpness is a one-line computation. The foot-point hull P(S) appears in no research literature that could be found, and the only source for the result is an unrefereed preprint. Neither plausible paper-worthiness nor a specific research audience is established for the selected result. Showing research interest would require mathematics beyond what is selected (for example a general-group or higher-dimensional theory with independent reception).
